title: Baba Vanga predicts his Kalmykia presidency

tellings.quote: And then all of a sudden, she tells me, "Ah, you'll go back home. You'll be the leader. You'll be president there."

plain: A former president of Kalmykia, a republic inside Russia, says that around 1990 the Bulgarian seer known as Baba Vanga told him he would go home and lead his people: "You'll be the leader. You'll be president there." He tells Michels this as something he lived through, and mentions a telegram from Bulgaria as part of the story. If true, it would mean she foresaw his rise to power before it happened, in the early 1990s.
